boot.db_credentials_command: RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails runner 'db = Rails.application.credentials.db; puts [db.name, db.username, db.password].join("|")'
db_setup_commands: RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load
boot.server_command: RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails server -e test -b 127.0.0.1 -p {port} -P {pidfile} -d --no-log-to-stdout
